{{Top|leg}}
'''Signal tappers''' were a type of device used to monitor [[Comm unit/Legends|communications]]. They were used by [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|separatists]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during their [[Separatist War|war]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
